Subject: Kickoff: Redwood procurement onboarding & PO routing for Acme Styles

Hi Maria / Acme team,

Thanks for partnering with Redwood — excited to get Acme Styles set up to receive POs and invoices. To get moving I have two asks today:

1) Please create a vendor account in your chosen procurement portal (Coupa recommended) using the email vendor-admin@acme-styles.com. If you hit any errors, reply with screenshots.

2) Complete the attached onboarding_checklist.xlsx and return the PDF copy. Key items we need: legal entity name, W-9 / Tax ID, remit-to address, and primary invoice email.

Notes and links:
- Coupa vendor portal: https://supplier.coupa.com (choose "Register")
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/99827/company/Acme-Styles (I added the initial company record)

We also need to configure PO routing so POs can hit the correct accounting owner at Acme. I’ve cc’d Laura (procurement ops) and Ben (account exec) to coordinate the buyer details.

If you prefer, we can do a quick 20-minute screen-share this afternoon to walk through the portal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer 
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks — we tried registering just now but hit two problems:

1) During account creation Coupa returned: "Organization not found — contact support" after we entered our legal name and Tax ID. Attached is the signup page screenshot (signup_error.png).

2) We attempted to connect SSO (we are on Okta) and the portal returned a NameID/Entity mismatch when posting the SAML response. Our Okta admin says the NameID in their assertion uses email (maria.lopez@acme-styles.com) but the Coupa tenant expects an entity claim of the parent company.

Also — where should we send our W-9? The onboarding checklist asks for Tax ID and remit address but the portal is blocking us before we can complete it.

We're available for a screen-share at 2pm PT if that helps.

Best,
Maria Lopez

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood procurement onboarding & PO routing for Acme Styles

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note before we reply to Acme:

- The "Organization not found" usually means the Coupa tenant's org mapping hasn't been published or the vendor's legal name doesn't match the verified mapping. I recommend we open a support ticket and ask Coupa to perform a manual provisioning / org map check.
- For the SSO NameID mismatch: ask Acme to share the SAML metadata (IdP metadata) and confirm which attribute they map as "NameID". If their NameID is email but Coupa expects a federated entity (company-level identifier), support can either update the expectation or we can set up a separate supplier tenant to accept email NameIDs.
- I'll pull the HubSpot company record (HS-99827) and add the onboarding checklist items we are missing. Ben, can you confirm which Redwood buyer/account to map for PO routing? We need a buyer code and GL routing — if the buyer wants POs to go to AP at acme-payables@acme-styles.com make sure we record that.

I'm attaching a CSV with our recent org mappings to speed support (org_mapping.csv). I'll open the Coupa ticket now and include the screenshots.

Laura
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: org_mapping.csv

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:40:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Support: Account provisioning for Acme Styles (Case COUPA-54210)

Hi Karthik / Laura / Maria,

We reviewed the screenshots and the tenant configuration. We've manually provisioned Acme Styles to the correct account mapping and cleared the org lookup failure. Maria: you should now be able to finish registration.

For the SSO issue: Coupa expects the federated entity to match the registered legal entity value by default. If your IdP is sending an email NameID we can either (A) update the tenant to accept email NameIDs for that supplier or (B) request your Okta admin to send the company entity as a separate attribute (CompanyName or OrganizationID).

Next steps we recommend:
- Maria: retry the registration flow and upload W-9 under the "Tax & Invoicing" tab.
- Karthik / Laura: please confirm the buyer routing code and AP email so we can add PO routing on our side.
- If you prefer, we can schedule a short call to flip IdP settings; we have a best-practice doc here: https://support.coupa.com/kb/sso-setup (see section "Supplier NameID patterns").

Case: COUPA-54210
Provisioning notes: manual org map added, SSO attribute options documented.

Regards,
Coupa Support
support@coupa.com
